startup_resolution.name: kt_ids
startup_resolution.source: kind_type scan kind IN ('movie','tv movie','video movie','direct-to-video' or 'video game')
startup_resolution.notes: template literal set varies; load 4 ids; also keep id->kind string map for MIN(kt.kind)

filters.predicate: info_type_id==it1_id AND note LIKE '%internet%' AND (info LIKE 'USA:% 199%' OR 'USA:% 200%')

join_order.build: title(driver, filtered by kt_ids and year>1990)
join_order.notes: title is driver; iterate v=1..N filtered; check existence via offsets_only indexes per fact

per_row_steps.op: scan cc[off[v]..off[v+1]) where status_id==cct1_id; require >=1 match
scan mc[off[v]..off[v+1]) where country_code[company_id-1]==us_code; require >=1 match
scan mi[off[v]..off[v+1]) where info_type_id==it1_id AND note contains 'internet' AND info has 'USA:' prefix AND (memmem ' 199' OR ' 200'); require >=1 match
per_row_steps.rationale: expensive LIKEs last; cheaper filters short-circuit

per_row_steps.op: update running MIN(kt.kind via kt_id_to_kind_str[kind_id]) and MIN(t.title)

data_structures.cn_country_code_array: raw int32_t* mmap of company_name/country_code.bin (dict codes), indexed by company_id-1
data_structures.offsets: mmap int32_t arrays for cc/mc/mk/mi movie_id offsets
data_structures.fact_columns: mmap raw .bin (status_id, company_id, info_type_id) + variable-length .off/.dat for note/info
data_structures.running_min: two std::string (or string_view tracking) for movie_kind and title

parallelism.morsel: title row range partitions (~ N/12 each)
parallelism.reduction: per-thread local MIN pair, final reduction lexicographic min
